required_qualifications: The outer shell weight w is nonnegative; the AFE weight W changes sign. Only local W->1 or W>=1/2 on x<=1 is used for the near-core lower bound.

The positive diagonal scale is for the full Mobius block and fixed nonzero nonnegative w. Bounded masks retain the uniform upper bound, not a uniform lower bound; uniform lower constants for a weight family would need its integral bounded below.
Neither the positive diagonal nor the positive unsigned near-core is a lower bound for the full mixed moment or its signed off-diagonal.
The T^(5/3) count is a genuine actual-cloud lower bound after subtracting O(ND) exact collisions, not an asymptotic pair count and not a lower bound for every taper.
The actual missing bound is the aggregate weighted signed combination. The stated per-N bound with a delta reserve is sufficient and stronger, not necessary.
Retain all N from order 1 through T^(1/2+eps), bounded comparable dyadic partners, and the exact interval masks and coefficient conjugates needed by the application.
Require fixed open-neighborhood uniformity and eta+rho<1/6, with one paid aggregate loss budget; eta+rho+delta<1/6 is a stronger sufficient separation.

Use the valid fixed smooth shell majorant, or genuinely overlapping rescaled covering weights; do not interpret the alternative wording as finite smooth majorization with support confined exactly to the closed sharp shell.
This pass concerns Sections 1-4 as an interface audit. The off-diagonal saving itself, a new variance theorem, literature exhaustiveness, novelty, and RH are not certified.
